mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a hidden plumbing leak in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a hidden plumbing leak in a bathroom include unexpected increases in your water bill, damp or stained walls/ceilings adjacent to the bathroom, peeling paint or wallpaper, persistent musty odors, or warped flooring. You might also notice a decrease in water pressure or hear the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use. Addressing these signs promptly can prevent more significant water damage and costly repairs in your home in areas like Albany or Kensington.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for unexplained high water bills, damp spots on walls or floors, musty smells, or the sound of running water when nothing is on, as these often signal a hidden leak.
